title: From a conversation with a lead to an article: the six-step page
detail: /lead-to-article/: ask for a yes, record a 30-second memo, the private follow-up drafted the same evening in the CRM, an article only with their yes, hot leads to Nimay or Dinis within a day. Indi settled: spoken yes for a short mention, signed approval for a full interview; same-evening drafts; the newsroom publishes.
recommend: Adopt it as written, so everyone can use it from Monday
